label: intoItselfDirectOnly: move refuses only a parent that is the node or its direct child
find: if parent == id || ancestors(of: parent)?.contains(id) == true { throw .intoItself(parent) }
replace: if parent == id || ancestors(of: parent)?.last == id { throw .intoItself(parent) }

label: cascadeOwnFlagOnly: isEffectivelyHidden reads the node's own isHidden and ignores its ancestors
bringForwardAtTopWraps: bringForward on the front layer wraps it to the back instead of staying
ungroupDropsOrder: ungroup puts the group's children back in reverse order
